observations: Photo shows a keyboard/synth-style instrument with many keys on the left and a control panel with buttons/ports and a small display on the right.
A label on the front panel appears to read 'PSR-550' (partially visible).
There is visible wear/dust and some scuffing on the control area and speaker grille.

claims.evidence: No photo/video showing it powered on, audio output, or all functions working.

risks.risk: Power/audio may be faulty (speaker, output, or power supply issue) even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: Short video: power on + play a few notes + show volume working and confirm sound from the built-in speaker.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs repair).

risks.risk: Some keys/buttons may be dead or intermittent.
risks.proof: Video clip showing a full octave test (left-to-right keys) and pressing multiple panel buttons/controls.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having possible missing/weak keys or controls.

risks.risk: Display/backlight or screen functions may be damaged.
risks.proof: Photo/video close-up of the screen while powered on, showing readable menu/settings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as screen may be unreliable.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, cables) or wrong charger.
risks.proof: Photo of all included items laid out (charger/power cable, pedals, manuals) and a close-up of the charging port.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming buyer may need to source missing accessories.

proof_requests: Send a video of the keyboard powered on with sound (built-in speaker) and volume control working.
Send a close-up photo of the model/serial label (to confirm PSR-550) and the screen while on.
Show a quick key test across the keyboard and a few panel buttons (demo/voice/style).
List and photograph included accessories (power adapter/charger, sustain pedal, cables).
response.reason: The photo suggests a Yamaha PSR-550, but the seller’s 'working perfectly' claim is not verifiable remotely without a powered-on test showing sound and key/panel functionality.
